title: Star Logistics Employee Receives Prestigious Country Mile Award from Tractor Supply
summary: Covenant Logistics congratulates Michelle Roberts on prestigious recognition
body_markdown:
Star Logistics, a Covenant Logistics Group company, is proud to recognize Michelle Roberts for receiving Tractor Supply's prestigious Country Mile Award during their Annual Partnership Conference.


The Country Mile Award recognizes individuals who consistently go above and beyond in support of Tractor Supply's business, demonstrating exceptional commitment, communication, service, and partnership. Only a select number of recipients are recognized each year, making it one of the organization's highest individual partner honors.


Michelle was selected for her unwavering dedication to Tractor Supply and the strong partnership she has helped build over the years.


> "This is a high-level award for an individual that shows operational and communication excellence and goes above and beyond for their customer.” said Stephen Grace, SVP of Star Logistics, “Michelle is a true advocate for Tractor Supply and our company; she treats the business as her own."


For Michelle, the recognition reflects a relationship built on trust, responsiveness, and a shared commitment to serving communities across the country.


> "It is truly an honor to receive the Country Mile Award from Tractor Supply," Michelle said. "Tractor Supply is more than just a customer to me. They are family. I take great pride in being a trusted partner and helping support the day-to-day needs of communities across the country, as well as being there when times of crisis arise and emergency transportation is needed."


The award comes during a period of continued success for the partnership between Tractor Supply and Star Logistics, a Covenant Logistics Group company. In 2025, Star was named Tractor Supply's Supply Chain Partner of the Year, recognized for its outstanding support during Hurricanes Helene and Milton. Through proactive planning, emergency transportation management, and around-the-clock coordination, Star helped ensure critical supplies reached affected communities when they were needed most.


Since the relationship began in 2019, Star has become a trusted transportation partner for Tractor Supply, supporting everything from everyday freight needs to emergency response operations. The partnership has grown through a shared focus on reliability, scalability, and service excellence.


Michelle's recognition is a reflection of those values in action. Her customer-first approach, operational expertise, and dedication to doing the right thing have strengthened one of Star's most important partnerships and embody the culture that continues to drive success across the organization.


Please join us in congratulating Michelle on this well-deserved achievement.
